contenders.handicapper_notes: Dominant last-start course-and-distance winner over 1350m at Doomben in F&M BM65 grade on July 22. Chris Waller stable keeps her weighted ideally at 120lbs. She possesses excellent tactical speed and handles the tight Doomben turns smoothly.

Tony Gollan-trained gelding drawing barrier 2, providing a golden box-seat trail over the 1350m trip. Fitter second-up after a solid 3rd over 1200m at Ipswich. Drops to 122lbs with Ben Thompson riding for Doomben's premier stable.

Second-up drop-down from Eagle Farm BM70 metropolitan grade where he finished a strong 6th beaten just 2.5 lengths. Brings high-level Sydney Metro and Provincial form lines and receives class drop bonus into midweek Class 3 level.
Flagged as the primary danger horse. Ran a brave 3rd over this track and distance on July 22 in BM65 company. Apprentice Jace McMurray claims weight relief down to effective 123lbs.
Resuming for Chris Waller off a 4.5-month letup. Draws inside barrier 3 to save ground along the rail, carrying a light 121lbs with Emily Lang's claim. Won over 1600m at Ipswich prior to spell.
Landed his maiden victory over 1400m at Sunshine Coast last start. Benefiter of official scratches, securing stall 1 on the rail with Mark Plessis retaining the ride at 120lbs.
